lines.text: David calls on the heavenly beings to ascribe glory and strength to the LORD and worship Him in holiness.
The voice of the LORD is over the waters, and it is powerful and majestic.
The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars of Lebanon and strikes with hailstones.
The voice of the LORD shakes the Wilderness of Sinai, twists the oaks, and strips the forests bare.
The LORD is enthroned as King forever over the flood, and He blesses His people with peace.
